definitions.explanation: A topical cream, lotion, or oral medicine that relieves itching from insect bites, rashes, or allergies.

examples.japanese: かゆみ{止|ど}めを{塗|ぬ}った。
{虫|むし}に{刺|さ}されたので、かゆみ{止|ど}めを{買|か}ってきた。
examples.english: I got bitten by a bug, so I bought some anti-itch medicine.

examples.japanese: {子供|こども}が{湿疹|しっしん}をかかないように、かゆみ{止|ど}めを{塗|ぬ}ってあげた。
examples.english: I put anti-itch cream on my child so they wouldn't scratch the rash.

notes:
Formed from かゆみ (itch) + {止|ど}め (stopper, from {止|と}める "to stop"). The same {〜止|ど}め pattern names many remedies.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- かゆみ{止|ど}めを{塗|ぬ}る: to apply anti-itch cream
- かゆみ{止|ど}めの{薬|くすり}: anti-itch medicine

RELATED:
- {痛|いた}み{止|ど}め: painkiller
- {虫|むし}{除|よ}け: insect repellent
